abstract: Mouse egg-cylinders of C3H/H strain with two and three germ layers were transplanted under the kidney capsule. They developed into well differentiated teratomas and teratocarcinomas. Older embryos developed invariably into teratomas composed of adult tissues only. We consider the period of germ layer inversion as a critical stage when embryonic cells loose their potentiality for uncontrolled growth.
abstract_ja: 2層および3層の胚葉を持つC3H/H系マウスの卵円柱を腎被膜下に移植した。若い移植片は分化の良好な奇形腫および奇形癌へと発達した。年長の胚は常に、成体組織のみで構成された奇形腫へと発達した。胚葉反転の時期は、胚細胞が無制御な増殖能を失う重要な段階であると考えられる。
